name: grill-me
title: Grill Me
description: Relentlessly question the user until the design concept is shared and the key decisions are explicit.
command_description: Interrogate the task until the design concept is explicit and decision-ready.
prompt: Run this workflow for medium or large work, especially when the request touches multiple subsystems, changes user-visible behavior, has more than one plausible implementation path, or needs rollout or migration thinking. Interview the user aggressively about the problem, goals, non-goals, scope boundaries, interfaces, failure modes, rollout, and tradeoffs until the design concept is shared. Treat missing user-visible outcome, unclear in-scope or out-of-scope boundary, unknown integration boundary, undefined failure behavior, and undefined data model change as ambiguity that must be resolved before coding. Prefer targeted yes/no questions or short explicit options. Externalize the result to docs/ai/design_concept.md instead of leaving it only in chat history.
